items.title: Effect of iTBS and rTMS Combined with Robotic Rehabilitation on Ambulation and Lower Extremity Motor Function in Chronic SCI Patients.
items.summary: A single-blind RCT (n=30) found that both rTMS and iTBS combined with robotic rehabilitation improved lower-extremity motor function (LEMS: rTMS median +4.0, iTBS +5.0 vs sham +0.0; SCIM III: rTMS +3.0, iTBS +5.0 vs sham +0.0) and ambulation (10 MWT: rTMS +6.6, iTBS +5.7 vs sham +0.7) in chronic incomplete SCI patients at 4-week follow-up, with no significant differences between active groups.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性不完全性脊髓损伤患者，rTMS 和 iTBS 结合机器人康复均能改善下肢功能和步态，且两种主动干预方案之间无显著差异。这提示将这些神经调控技术纳入康复方案，但需注意在不同结局指标上与安慰剂组的差异性表现。
items.titleZh: iTBS 和 rTMS 结合机器人康复对慢性脊髓损伤患者步态和下肢运动功能的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照试验（n=30）发现，rTMS 和 iTBS 结合机器人康复在 4 周随访期能改善慢性不完全性脊髓损伤患者的下肢运动功能（LEMS: rTMS 中位数 +4.0，iTBS +5.0，安慰剂 +0.0；SCIM III: rTMS +3.0，iTBS +5.0，安慰剂 +0.0）和步态（10 米步行测试: rTMS +6.6，iTBS +5.7，安慰剂 +0.7），且两主动干预组间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic incomplete SCI patients, both rTMS and iTBS combined with robotic rehabilitation improved lower-extremity function and ambulation, with no significant differences between the two active interventions. This suggests incorporating these neuromodulation techniques into rehabilitation, but note the varied performance compared to sham across different outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心、单盲试验，样本量较小（每组10人），且未观察到两种主动协议之间的显著差异。
items.limitationEn: This study was a single-center, single-blind trial with a small sample size (10 participants per group), and no significant differences were observed between the two active protocols.

items.title: Shear wave elastography for assessing lower extremity muscle stiffness after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A systematic review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 6 studies (173 ACLR participants) found reduced passive vastus medialis shear modulus in operative limbs (Hedges' g -1.10 to -1.21 vs controls), associated with quadriceps strength, knee function, and landing biomechanics. Semitendinosus stiffness was reduced after hamstring tendon harvest (g -1.29 to -1.64).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述肯定了剪切波弹性成像（SWE）在 ACLR 术后评估股内侧肌和半腱肌刚度缺陷的潜力。对于术后力量达标但运动模式仍有异常的患者，SWE 或能提供超越肌力评估的机械解释，支持更精准的康复干预，特别是股内侧肌和腘绳肌供区。
items.titleZh: 剪切波弹性成像评估前交叉韧带重建术后下肢肌肉僵硬度的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 6 项研究（173 名 ACLR 受试者）的系统综述发现，手术肢体股内侧肌的被动剪切模量降低（Hedges' g -1.10 至 -1.21 对照组），这与股四头肌力量、膝关节功能和着陆生物力学相关。半腱肌刚度在腘绳肌腱取后降低（g -1.29 至 -1.64）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review affirms the potential of shear wave elastography (SWE) in assessing vastus medialis and semitendinosus stiffness deficits after ACLR. For patients who meet strength benchmarks but still exhibit abnormal movement patterns, SWE may offer mechanical explanations beyond strength assessment, supporting more precise rehabilitation interventions, especially for the vastus medialis and hamstring donor site.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的质量从差到好不等，且各研究协议标准化程度低，缺乏对特定临床相关区域的采样，限制了 SWE 在康复指导中的直接应用。
items.limitationEn: The quality of included studies ranged from poor to good, and protocols were not standardized, lacking sampling of specific clinically relevant regions, which limits the direct application of SWE in guiding rehabilitation.

items.title: Experiences of sexual rehabilitation post-stroke among LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and their partners: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative phenomenological study explored the experiences of 18 LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and 5 partners regarding post-stroke sexual rehabilitation, identifying themes of sexuality being addressed, negative interactions with health professionals, and the absence of sexuality in rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了 LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者及其伴侣在卒中后性康复方面的独特障碍和需求。在康复计划中，要避免异性恋假设，并主动与患者及其伴侣讨论性健康，考虑他们的性取向和性别认同。
items.titleZh: LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者及其伴侣的卒中后性康复经历：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性现象学研究探讨了 18 名 LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者和 5 名伴侣的卒中后性康复经历，发现性康复被提及、与医疗专业人员的负面互动以及康复中性话题的缺失等主题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals unique barriers and needs in post-stroke sexual rehabilitation for LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and their partners. In rehabilitation planning, avoid heteronormative assumptions and proactively discuss sexual health with patients and their partners, considering their sexual orientation and gender identity.
items.limitation: 研究样本主要为卒中幸存者（18人），伴侣仅5人，且研究未深入探讨跨性别、双性恋和双性人等特定 LGBTQI+ 群体的经验。
items.limitationEn: The study sample primarily consisted of stroke survivors (18 participants), with only 5 partners, and did not deeply explore the experiences of specific LGBTQI+ populations such as transgender, bisexual, and intersex individuals.

items.title: Burden of fall-related injury and its predictors among stroke survivors attending comprehensive specialized hospitals in the Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia, 2024: A multicenter prospective study.
items.summary: A multicenter cross-sectional study of 269 stroke survivors in Ethiopia found the prevalence of fall-related injury to be 79.9% (95% CI: 75.1-84.4). Predictors included age > 65 (AOR=2.670), rural residence (AOR=2.352), and injury occurring during walking and turning (AOR=2.960).
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心研究揭示埃塞俄比亚卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤的发生率高达 79.9%，且高龄、农村居住和步行转身时的损伤风险较高。在制定卒中康复和社区预防计划时，应高度关注这些高风险因素，并加强对农村地区老年患者的干预。
items.titleZh: 埃塞俄比亚阿姆哈拉州卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤负担及其预测因素：一项多中心前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对埃塞俄比亚 269 名卒中幸存者的多中心横断面研究显示，跌倒相关损伤的发生率为 79.9%（95% CI: 75.1-84.4）。预测因素包括年龄 > 65 岁（AOR=2.670）、农村居住（AOR=2.352）以及步行和转身时发生的损伤（AOR=2.960）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter study reveals a high prevalence of fall-related injuries (79.9%) among stroke survivors in Ethiopia, with increased risk associated with older age, rural residence, and injuries occurring during walking and turning. Stroke rehabilitation and community prevention programs should prioritize these high-risk factors and strengthen interventions for elderly patients in rural areas.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且所有数据均来自埃塞俄比亚的特定医院，结果可能不完全适用于其他地区或人群。
items.limitationEn: This study used a cross-sectional design, preventing causal inference, and all data were collected from specific hospitals in Ethiopia, so the findings may not be fully generalizable to other regions or populations.

items.title: Barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 older adults post-TKA in China identified three themes and 10 subthemes regarding decision-making for home-based rehabilitation, including intuitive avoidance responses (pain, fear, comfort preference), external support constraints, and rational adherence (prognosis threat, willpower, negotiation).
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了中国老年全膝关节置换术后患者居家康复决策的障碍与促进因素，特别是冲动系统与反射系统之间的认知冲突。你应认识到疼痛管理和个性化目标设定的重要性，并加强出院后的指导和家庭支持，以优化患者的居家康复依从性。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术后老年患者居家康复锻炼决策的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对中国 21 名全膝关节置换术后老年患者的定性研究，识别出居家康复决策的三个主题和十个亚主题，包括冲动性回避反应（疼痛、恐惧、偏好舒适）、外部支持限制以及理性依从（不良预后威胁、意志力、协商策略）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals barriers and facilitators for older Chinese adults in deciding on home-based rehabilitation exercises after total knee arthroplasty, particularly the cognitive conflicts between impulsive and reflective systems. You should recognize the importance of pain management and personalized goal setting, and strengthen post-discharge guidance and family support to optimize patient adherence to home-based rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（21名患者），且仅在中国三级医院招募，结果的普遍性受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a small sample size (21 patients) and was conducted only in tertiary hospitals in China, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Recent highlights in pulmonary rehabilitation research.
items.summary: This narrative review synthesized 5 key themes in pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) research from 2021-2026, highlighting expanded access strategies, effectiveness beyond stable COPD to various chronic respiratory diseases, alternative PR models, the importance of maintaining benefits, and growing economic evidence.
items.curatedReason: 这份叙述性综述强调了肺康复（PR）的广阔前景，其有效性已超越稳定期慢阻肺，覆盖多种慢性呼吸系统疾病，并发展出多样化的交付模式。这提示你应积极拓展 PR 的服务范围，尝试中心以外的交付模式，并重视行为改变技术以维持患者长期依从性。
items.titleZh: 肺康复研究的最新亮点
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述总结了 2021-2026 年肺康复 (PR) 研究的 5 个关键主题，强调了其在扩展可及性策略、对多种慢性呼吸系统疾病（超越稳定期慢阻肺）的有效性、替代 PR 模式、维持康复效果的重要性以及日益增长的经济学证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review highlights the broad prospects of pulmonary rehabilitation (PR), whose effectiveness now extends beyond stable COPD to various chronic respiratory diseases, with diverse delivery models emerging. This suggests you should actively expand PR services, explore non-center-based delivery models, and emphasize behavior change techniques to maintain long-term patient adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，所选研究的质量和临床重要性判断基于作者主观感知，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, the selection of studies based on perceived quality and clinical importance by the authors may introduce selection bias.

items.title: Movement matters: the path to professional impact.
items.summary: This article highlights Christopher M. Powers, PT, PhD, FAPTA, the 57th McMillan Lecturer, recognizing his leadership in human movement science and his extensive research in lower-extremity biomechanics, musculoskeletal injury, and evidence-based approaches to knee pain and sports injuries.

items.title: A Return to Performance Continuum for Football (Soccer) Players After ACL Reconstruction: Bridging Rehabilitation, Return to Play and Sustained Performance.
items.summary: This paper outlines a staged return-to-performance continuum for football players after ACL reconstruction, emphasizing a structured transition from return-to-sport clearance to sustained performance. It integrates on-field rehabilitation, team training, competitive match play, and early/sustained return to performance through four pillars: movement quality, technical/tactical re-training, physical reconditioning, and neuromuscular performance.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后的足球运动员重返赛场不仅要看短期恢复，更要关注长期表现。这份框架指南强调了从康复到持续高水平表现的过渡需要整合运动特异性训练、技战术再训练、体能重建和神经肌肉强化。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员 ACL 重建术后重返赛场表现的连续性：连接康复、重返赛场与持续表现
items.summaryZh: 本文概述了足球运动员 ACL 重建术后重返赛场表现的分阶段连续性框架，强调了从重返赛场许可到持续表现的结构化过渡。该框架通过四个支柱整合了场地康复、团队训练、竞赛以及早期/持续表现：运动质量、技战术再训练、体能再调节和神经肌肉表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: For football players after ACL reconstruction, return to sport involves more than short-term recovery; long-term performance is critical. This framework highlights the need for integrated sport-specific training, technical and tactical retraining, physical reconditioning, and neuromuscular performance restoration to transition from rehabilitation to sustained high-level performance.

items.title: Calf Injuries: An Anatomy-Based Approach to Diagnosis, Management and Return to Sport.
items.summary: This review discusses an anatomy-based approach to diagnosing, managing, and returning to sport after calf injuries, emphasizing precise characterization of myoconnective structures. It highlights that current evidence for linking anatomical patterns to prognosis is limited, and rehabilitation should be function-led with multifactorial return-to-sport decisions.
items.curatedReason: 小腿损伤的评估和管理应超越单一肌肉诊断，更精细地关注肌腱连接结构。记住康复应以功能为主导，重返运动决策是多因素综合考量，而非仅依赖影像学发现或固定时间表。
items.titleZh: 小腿损伤：基于解剖学的诊断、管理及重返运动方法
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述讨论了基于解剖学的小腿损伤诊断、管理和重返运动方法，强调了对肌腱连接结构进行精确表征。它指出目前将解剖学模式与预后关联的证据有限，康复应以功能为主导，重返运动决策是多因素综合考量。
items.curatedReasonEn: Calf injury assessment and management should move beyond single-muscle diagnoses to focus more precisely on myoconnective structures. Remember that rehabilitation should be function-led, and return-to-sport decisions are multifactorial, not solely reliant on imaging findings or fixed timelines.

items.title: Identifying heterogeneous patterns of real-world upper limb use beyond motor severity: a cross-sectional sensor-based study in people with subacute stroke
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 101 subacute stroke patients identified six heterogeneous upper limb activity patterns beyond motor severity using accelerometers and clinical assessments. Key distinguishing factors included motor function tests (ARAT), Motor Activity Log, upper limb inattention, and paretic-side dominance, suggesting personalized rehabilitation should consider factors beyond motor deficits.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，卒中患者上肢活动模式远比运动严重程度复杂，可以通过结合传感器数据和临床认知评估来识别不同的亚型。这提示你，制定个性化康复策略时，要考虑运动缺陷以外的注意力和行为因素，这能让你的干预更精准。
items.titleZh: 识别卒中亚急性期患者上肢真实世界使用中的异质模式：一项超越运动严重程度的基于传感器的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 101 名卒中亚急性期患者进行的横断面研究，利用加速度计和临床评估，识别出超越运动严重程度的六种异质性上肢活动模式。主要区别因素包括运动功能测试 (ARAT)、运动活动日志、上肢注意力不集中和偏瘫侧优势，提示个性化康复应考虑运动缺陷以外的因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates that upper limb activity patterns in stroke patients are far more complex than motor severity alone, and different subtypes can be identified by combining sensor data with clinical and cognitive assessments. This suggests that when developing personalized rehabilitation strategies, you should consider attentional and behavioral factors beyond motor deficits to make your interventions more precise.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确定因果关系，且传感器数据反映的是现实世界活动，但不能完全捕捉所有运动细节和代偿策略。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot determine causality, and while sensor data reflects real-world activity, it cannot fully capture all movement details and compensatory strategies.

items.title: The Role of Psychosocial Factors in Returning to Physical Activity and Sport Among Female Football Players After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injury: A Scoping Review
items.summary: A scoping review of seven studies found that psychosocial factors significantly influence female football players' return to physical activity and sport after ACL injury. Barriers included uncertainty, fear, lack of confidence, and poor social support, while facilitators were confidence, motivation, strong social support, and athletic identity.
items.curatedReason: 女性足球运动员 ACL 损伤后重返运动，心理社会因素是重要考量。这份范围综述揭示了不确定性、恐惧、信心不足和社群支持缺乏是阻碍因素；信心、动机、强劲的社群支持和运动员身份认同是促进因素。在你的临床实践中，除了生理康复，还要全面评估和支持患者的心理社会需求。
items.titleZh: 心理社会因素在女性足球运动员 ACL 损伤后重返体力活动和运动中的作用：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖七项研究的范围综述发现，心理社会因素显著影响女性足球运动员 ACL 损伤后重返体力活动和运动。障碍包括不确定性、恐惧、缺乏信心和不良社会支持，而促进因素则为信心、动机、强大的社会支持和运动员身份认同。
items.curatedReasonEn: Psychosocial factors are crucial for female football players returning to sport after ACL injury. This scoping review reveals uncertainty, fear, lack of confidence, and poor social support as barriers; while confidence, motivation, strong social support, and athletic identity are facilitators. In your clinical practice, beyond physiological rehabilitation, comprehensively assess and support patients' psychosocial needs.
items.limitation: 这是一项范围综述，而非系统综述，可能未对纳入研究的质量进行深入评估。纳入研究数量有限（7 篇），且对心理社会因素的探索深度可能不足。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, not a systematic review, and may not have deeply assessed the quality of included studies. The number of included studies is limited (7), and the depth of exploration into psychosocial factors may be insufficient.

items.title: Adherence to home-based exercise therapy in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain: a cross-sectional study of 491 participants of the ComPaRE cLBP e-cohort (ADHERE II).
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 491 adults with non-specific chronic low back pain found that adherence to home-based exercise therapy was 45%. Higher pre-onset physical activity, lower pain intensity, and lower treatment burden were associated with higher adherence, but supervision did not significantly influence it.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，慢性腰痛患者居家运动依从性仅为 45%，且监督干预未能显著提高依从性。应关注患者运动前的活跃度、疼痛强度和治疗负担，这些是影响依从性的关键因素。
items.titleZh: 非特异性慢性腰痛成人居家运动治疗依从性：一项涉及 491 名参与者的横断面研究 (ADHERE II)
items.summaryZh: 一项对 491 名非特异性慢性腰痛成人进行的横断面研究发现，居家运动治疗依从性为 45%。运动前身体活动水平较高、慢性腰痛强度较低以及治疗负担较轻与较高的居家运动依从性相关，但监督对依从性无显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study indicates that adherence to home-based exercise therapy for chronic low back pain patients is only 45%, and supervised intervention did not significantly improve adherence. Focus on patients' pre-exercise activity levels, pain intensity, and treatment burden, as these are key factors influencing adherence.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，依从性数据基于自我报告，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, and adherence data is based on self-report, which may introduce recall bias.

items.title: Toward personalized exergaming: a machine learning-based decision-support approach to cognitive-motor training for long-term care residents with cognitive impairments
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 100 long-term care residents with cognitive impairments developed a machine learning model to provide personalized exergaming recommendations. The model achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.79 for predicting gameplay ability, with individual game and cognitive status being the strongest determinants, while predicting assistance needs showed lower performance (AUC = 0.67–0.71).
items.curatedReason: 将机器学习应用于认知运动训练，能根据认知障碍老年居民的个体特征提供个性化游戏推荐和辅助需求。这提示你，未来康复可以利用数据驱动的工具更精准地定制干预方案，尤其是结合患者的认知状况来选择合适的训练游戏。
items.titleZh: 迈向个性化运动游戏：基于机器学习的认知运动训练决策支持方法，针对认知障碍长期护理居民
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名认知障碍长期护理居民的横断面研究开发了一个机器学习模型，用于提供个性化的运动游戏推荐。该模型在预测游戏能力方面达到了 0.79 的 ROC-AUC，其中个体游戏和认知状况是主要决定因素，而辅助需求预测表现较低 (AUC = 0.67–0.71)。
items.curatedReasonEn: Applying machine learning to cognitive-motor training can provide personalized game recommendations and assistance needs based on the individual characteristics of older residents with cognitive impairments. This suggests that future rehabilitation can leverage data-driven tools to more precisely tailor intervention plans, especially by considering patients' cognitive status when selecting appropriate training games.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法评估长期干预效果；模型的辅助需求预测性能（AUC 0.67–0.71）低于游戏能力预测（AUC 0.79）。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, so it cannot assess long-term intervention effects; the model's assistance needs prediction performance (AUC 0.67–0.71) is lower than gameplay ability prediction (AUC 0.79).

items.title: Effects of cluster-set vs. traditional resistance exercise with equated total rest on muscular performance, perceived fatigue, and cardiovascular responses in resistance-trained women
items.summary: A randomized crossover study of 12 resistance-trained women found that cluster-set configurations, with 10-s or 30-s intra-set rest and equated total rest, significantly improved muscular endurance performance and reduced perceived fatigue and cardiovascular load-to-work ratios compared to traditional sets, without altering post-set cardiovascular responses.
items.curatedReason: 对于有抗阻训练经验的女性，集束组（cluster-set）训练能在总休息时间相同的情况下，显著提高肌肉耐力表现，并降低主观疲劳和心血管负荷与做功比。考虑将集束组训练引入你的力量训练方案，以提高训练效率和受训者体验。
items.titleZh: 集束组与传统抗阻训练在总休息时间相同的情况下对有抗阻训练经验女性的肌肉表现、感知疲劳和心血管反应的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 12 名有抗阻训练经验女性进行的随机交叉研究发现，在总休息时间相同的情况下，包含 10 秒或 30 秒组内休息的集束组训练，与传统组训练相比，显著提高了肌肉耐力表现，并降低了感知疲劳和心血管负荷与做功比，同时不改变训练后的心血管反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: For resistance-trained women, cluster-set training significantly improves muscular endurance performance and reduces perceived fatigue and cardiovascular load-to-work ratios, even with equated total rest. Consider incorporating cluster-set training into your strength training programs to enhance training efficiency and trainee experience.
items.limitation: 样本量较小（12 名女性），且是急性效应研究，无法评估长期训练适应性。研究对象为有抗阻训练经验的女性，结果不一定适用于其他人群。
items.limitationEn: The sample size is small (12 women), and this is an acute effects study, so it cannot assess long-term training adaptations. The participants were resistance-trained women, so the results may not be applicable to other populations.

items.title:
Physiological determinants of endurance capacity in individuals with cerebral palsy: a narrative review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A narrative review synthesized evidence on the physiological determinants of endurance capacity in individuals with cerebral palsy, finding consistent impairments in cardiorespiratory fitness, ventilatory patterns, and skeletal muscle structure/metabolism. These integrated central and peripheral factors constrain endurance, with more pronounced effects in individuals with greater functional limitations, suggesting adapted training modalities like Frame Running show promise.
items.curatedReason: 这份叙述性综述综合了脑瘫患者耐力能力的生理决定因素。它清晰地指出，心肺、血液、肌肉骨骼多系统功能受损共同限制了耐力，且功能受限越重影响越大。这提示你，制定脑瘫患者的康复计划，需要多系统干预，尤其要关注适应性训练模式，如 Frame Running。
items.titleZh: 脑瘫患者耐力能力的生理决定因素：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项叙述性综述综合了脑瘫患者耐力能力的生理决定因素，发现心肺适能、通气模式以及骨骼肌结构/代谢存在持续性损伤。这些整合的中央和外周因素限制了耐力，功能受限越大的个体影响越显著，表明适应性训练模式如 Frame Running 有望改善这些结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review synthesizes the physiological determinants of endurance capacity in individuals with cerebral palsy. It clearly states that multisystem impairments (cardiopulmonary, hematological, musculoskeletal) collectively limit endurance, with greater functional limitations leading to more pronounced effects. This suggests that rehabilitation plans for cerebral palsy patients require multisystem interventions, with particular attention to adaptive training modalities like Frame Running.
items.limitation: 作为一篇叙述性综述，它可能存在选择性偏倚，且未对纳入研究的证据质量进行系统评估，结论可能不够严谨。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, it may suffer from selection bias and has not systematically assessed the quality of evidence in the included studies, potentially leading to less rigorous conclusions.

items.title: Here are the Speech Language Therapy Coding Changes Going Into Effect on January 1, 2027
items.summary: The CPT Editorial Panel is replacing the single speech language therapy code 92507 with ten new, more specific codes for fluency, speech sound production, language comprehension/expression, and voice/upper airway/resonance disorders, effective January 1, 2027.
items.curatedReason: 美国言语治疗领域 CPT 编码将发生重大变化：旧的 92507 代码将被 10 个新的更具体的代码取代，并于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效。如果你是言语治疗师，需要立即了解这些新编码，因为它会直接影响你的服务报销。
items.titleZh: 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效的言语语言治疗编码变更
items.summaryZh: CPT 编辑委员会将用十个更具体的新代码取代单一的言语语言治疗代码 92507，这些新代码涵盖流利性障碍、语音生成障碍、语言理解/表达障碍以及发声/上气道/共鸣障碍，将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效。
items.curatedReasonEn: Significant changes are coming to CPT coding for speech-language therapy in the US: the old 92507 code will be replaced by 10 new, more specific codes, effective January 1, 2027. If you are a speech-language pathologist, you need to understand these new codes immediately as they will directly impact your service reimbursement.

items.title: Appraisal of Clinical Practice Guideline: physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder.
items.summary: This paper provides an appraisal of the clinical practice guideline for the physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床实践指南评估报告为儿童发育性协调障碍的物理治疗管理提供了最新依据。它能帮助你优化对这类儿童的治疗方案，确保干预措施的循证性。
items.titleZh: 临床实践指南评估：发育性协调障碍儿童的物理治疗管理
items.summaryZh: 本文对发育性协调障碍儿童物理治疗管理的临床实践指南进行了评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical practice guideline appraisal report provides the latest evidence for physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder. It can help you optimize treatment plans for these children, ensuring evidence-based interventions.

items.title: Relaxation interventions in neurological rehabilitation: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified 63 sources on relaxation interventions in neurological rehabilitation, primarily in multiple sclerosis and stroke patients. Interventions are generally feasible and well-accepted, with outcomes mostly assessed at the body structure and function level, particularly psychological functioning, but noted a heterogeneous evidence landscape and key research gaps.
items.curatedReason: 在神经康复中，放松干预措施的可行性和接受度普遍较高，但其有效性证据仍分散且多关注心理功能。这份综述提示我们，在将其广泛应用于临床前，还需要更多高质量研究来明确这些干预措施在具体疾病和功能层面的确切疗效，而非仅限于心理层面。
items.titleZh: 神经康复中的放松干预：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述纳入了63项关于神经康复中放松干预的研究，主要集中在多发性硬化症和卒中患者。研究发现这些干预措施通常可行且接受度高，结果主要评估身体结构和功能层面，尤其心理功能，但证据存在异质性且研究空白较多。
items.curatedReasonEn: Relaxation interventions in neurorehabilitation are generally feasible and well-accepted, but evidence for their efficacy remains fragmented and largely focused on psychological outcomes. This review suggests that before widespread clinical adoption, more high-quality research is needed to define the precise therapeutic effects of these interventions across specific conditions and functional levels, beyond just psychological benefits.
items.limitation: 该综述揭示了现有证据的异质性，并指出在研究不常见神经疾病、采用定性设计和比较效果研究以及评估感知生理压力、活动和参与方面存在显著空白。
items.limitationEn: The review highlights the heterogeneity of existing evidence and significant gaps in research for less prevalent neurological conditions, qualitative designs, comparative effectiveness studies, and assessments of perceived physiological stress, activities, and participation.
